title: Brandson: back to the detailed crown locs, not as big on top (owner); look notes updated

value.notes: Fred Warner style: a high-top of short twisted locs standing up and back from the crown, falling over the shoulders; short stubble beard on a strong jaw; huge and 6'7", muscular V-taper (not fat). Signature (owner): arms crossed, menacing, helmet off [IMG_6206 + IMG_6201]. Face (owner): chiseled, triangular: wide cheekbones tapering to a strong, narrower pointed chin and a defined jawline. Locs (owner): the detailed crown of thick two-tone loc strands (twist glints, lighter tips) falling round the face to the jaw and neck, but not as big on top (a lower crown); nothing hangs behind. Jaw (owner): pushed out 1 px each side, ending a row higher in a blunter chin (the point was too sharp); cheekbones, brow and eyes unchanged

mutations.reason: Owner: go back to Sherman's old hair, it was more detailed, just don't make it as big on the top
